event.title: International Criminal Court Votes to Remove Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan
event.canonical_title: International Criminal Court Votes to Remove Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan
event.summary: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has voted to dismiss chief prosecutor Karim Khan following allegations of sexual misconduct. This decision comes nearly two years after the allegations first surfaced. Khan has denied the claims, which include accusations of engaging in an improper relationship with a junior staff member and attempting to prevent her from pursuing her complaint.

key_facts: Karim Khan was removed from his position as Chief Prosecutor of the ICC.
The vote to dismiss him was held by ICC member states.
Allegations against Khan include sexual misconduct and attempts to silence a complaint.
